content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text uses Luke 2:48-49 and its internal qualification as the reason to mark the clash UNDERDETERMINED, which is the kind of single-verse ground K-S2 governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D4 vs C2 (Luke 2:48-49): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] §5 and [CR3] LINK 4; Mary's phrase \"thy father\" is immediately qualified by the child's reference to \"my Father's business.\"","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that admits both readings, with nothing else settling it, is such a verse.","room":"A verse that admits both readings, with nothing else settling it — I weighed whether the judge's citation of the immediate qualification is still a single-verse ground that K-S2 forbids, or instead is something else settling it so the rule does not apply.","why":"The judge grounds UNDERDETERMINED on Luke 2:48-49's internal tension between 'thy father' and 'my Father's business,' i.e., a single verse admitting both readings without citing anything else that settles it, which K-S2 forbids."}
